if m:
    data = json.loads\(m.group\(1\)\)
    pp = data.get\('props',{}\).get\('pageProps',{}\)
    # List all keys at pageProps level
    print\('pageProps keys:', list\(pp.keys\(\)\)\)
    # Check for dehydrated state
    dh = pp.get\('dehydratedState',{}\)
    if dh:
        queries = dh.get\('queries',[]\)
        print\(f'dehydratedState has {len\(queries\)} queries'\)
        for i, q in enumerate\(queries\):
            state = q.get\('state',{}\).get\('data',{}\)
            if isinstance\(state, dict\):
                print\(f'  query {i} keys: {list\(state.keys\(\)\)[:10]}'\)
                for k, v in state.items\(\):
                    if isinstance\(v, list\) and len\(v\) > 0:
                        print\(f'    {k}: list of {len\(v\)}, first item keys: {list\(v[0].keys\(\)\)[:10] if isinstance\(v[0], dict\) else type\(v[0]\)}'\)
            elif isinstance\(state, list\):
                print\(f'  query {i}: list of {len\(state\)}'\)
" 2>/dev/null)

import sys, re
html = sys.stdin.read\(\)
# Find all time elements
times = re.findall\(r'<time[^>]*datetime=[\\"']\([^\\"']*\)[\\"'][^>]*>\([^<]*\)</time>', html\)
print\(f'Found {len\(times\)} time elements'\)
for t in times[:10]:
    print\(f'  datetime=\\"{t[0]}\\" text=\\"{t[1].strip\(\)}\\"'\)

# Also check for listdate spans
dates = re.findall\(r'class=[\\"'][^\\"']*listdate[^\\"']*[\\"'][^>]*>\([^<]*\)<', html\)
print\(f'\\nFound {len\(dates\)} listdate elements'\)
for d in dates[:10]:
    print\(f'  \\"{d.strip\(\)}\\"'\)

# Count job cards
cards = len\(re.findall\(r'base-card|job-search-card|base-search-card', html\)\)
print\(f'\\nJob cards found: {cards}'\)
" 2>/dev/null)
